tasks.short: Train drill crews and introduce procedures

steps.what: Train crews and introduce approved procedures through demonstrations, practice and understanding checks

tasks.design: The operator teaches and introduces approved procedures using current {DOCS}. Practical demonstration and understanding checks retain full time; no automatic procedure author or competence decision is proposed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Training depends on actual equipment, crew experience and site conditions.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing procedure material supports practical instruction.
tasks.still_hard: Establish that crew members understand and can apply the procedure.

evidence.claim: Billing-report software in the digest does not replace hands-on drilling instruction.

assumptions: The task boundary is introducing and teaching procedures within the existing authorization process.
No repetitive clerical training phase is invented.
Existing documents suffice; no new automation maintenance is introduced.
unknowns: Training arrangements and procedure approval responsibilities
research_questions: Which observed training activities are repetitive administration rather than required practical instruction?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Practical teaching and understanding checks remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Capture footage drilled, strata observations, location, tools, materials, services and time
Maintain drilling records from captured events without rekeying duplicate logs
Check drilling records and resolve discrepancies against original observations

tasks.design: Configure one drilling-event form in the existing {OPS_SYSTEM} and use its saved records instead of spreadsheet recopying. The operator captures observations and checks the log; neither strata classification nor measurements are inferred from billing data.
tasks.previous_blocker: Field observations may be copied into several logs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record forms can retain captured event data once.
tasks.still_hard: Correctly identify strata, depth, material use and event timing.
tasks.altitude: Own traceable drilling records rather than duplicate transcription.

evidence.claim: Dynamics 365 Field Service captures service tasks and parts in a report; that does not demonstrate geological logging capability or savings.
A native drilling-event register can avoid duplicate transcription after manual capture; the proposed time effect is unmeasured.

assumptions: The operator produces well or job ID, location, event time, depth interval, units, observed strata description, tool/material IDs, quantities, service description and duration in s1; its 45 hours includes observation and all capture.
Uncertain strata or missing readings remain explicitly unresolved and return to manual checking in s3; no automatic sensor feed or geological interpretation is assumed.
Use native operational forms before a new application.
Seven additional focal hours and two other-role hours per 100 baseline hours cover field definitions, corrections and access support.
This task owns the operational event record; any later billing report must reuse it without claiming this capture saving twice.
Live monitoring and bit selection remain in their separate physical task.
unknowns: Available operational form and offline behavior
research_questions: Can the native register remove duplicate records after observation, capture and reconciliation remain?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=70; gross 30 minus 7 focal upkeep gives central net 23%. Range 0-15% allows uncertain duplicate-entry share and correction workload; existing single-entry logs save zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Direct rig crews during drilling, setup, completion and well servicing activities

tasks.design: Retain live crew direction with the operator using current plans in {DOCS} and existing {TELEPHONY}. A digital record does not replace on-site coordination or change the command arrangement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Crew direction depends on changing conditions and shared situational understanding.
tasks.still_hard: Coordinate appropriate actions when conditions differ from the plan.
tasks.human_edge: Connect observed conditions with crew capabilities and actions.

evidence.claim: Live rig-crew direction is retained without a software-only labour-saving claim.

assumptions: This baseline is direct coordination, not duplicated log entry.
Existing communication and documents remain; no new automation upkeep is introduced.
research_questions: Are any separate administrative handoffs consuming time outside live crew direction?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Live crew direction retains full time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor drilling and select and change bits

steps.what: Monitor drilling progress and select suitable drill bits from observed strata conditions
Change drill bits using hand tools under existing operating procedures

tasks.design: Keep monitoring, selection and the physical bit change with the operator. Existing {OPS_SYSTEM} indications and {DOCS} support the work; the separate record register does not make selection or equipment changes automatic.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selection depends on live drilling behavior and actual strata.
tasks.still_hard: Assess changing conditions and perform the physical intervention correctly.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize conditions that the written plan does not capture.
tasks.altitude: Own informed equipment selection and physical execution.

evidence.claim: Monitoring, bit selection and physical bit changes retain their full time in this design.

assumptions: No new instrumentation, robotic intervention or control algorithm is proposed.
Existing equipment and procedures remain, with no additional automation maintenance.
Recordkeeping is assigned to the separate logging task and does not remove live attention here.
research_questions: What monitoring and physical work remains after any existing equipment automation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net 0. Monitoring, judgement and physical tool work remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Own crew understanding, traceable observations and informed physical drilling decisions.
reach: Support extraction supervisors with reconciled records
Coordinate equipment handoffs with derrick operators
role.ambitious_version: An operator who records observations once while protecting time for practical crew training, direct coordination and equipment judgement.

job.title: Rotary Drill Operators, Oil and Gas
